{{Top}}
'''Gold Seven''' was the callsign of the second member of [[Gold Squadron]]. There were a number of starfighter squadrons with this name, and several beings went by the name Gold Seven.

==History==
'''Gold Seven''' was the callsign of [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="RS">*[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 25|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 25]]</ref> 

It was later assigned to [[Lussatte]] while she was training as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Hunt for Zsinj|campaign]] against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]].<ref name="if">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>
